stemMd: From a point 12 m from a tower base, the angle of elevation has tangent 5/12. Ignoring eye height, how tall is the tower?
explanationMd: Tangent is height divided by horizontal distance. Therefore height=$12(5/12)=5$ m. The 13 m value would be the line-of-sight distance.
